Description.Title: Mole 2026: cell-resolved CREST implantation, 6-9 d.p.f.
Description.Details: Source: Mole et al., Cell 189 (2026), DOI 10.1016/j.cell.2025.10.027. The source is an experimental 3D tissue culture, NOT a dynamical computational model. This is a 2D CPM + reaction-diffusion + cell-state approximation. Anchors: ~180 um tissue thickness (PDF p5); ~50 um gland depth (Fig2H, p6); apposition 6 d.p.f., adhesion ~7, implantation ~8 (Fig3A-D, p8, methods p30). PROS1 (trophoblast) -> AXL (stromal), and R428 outgrowth defect (Fig7, p14-16). EFNA1/EPHA2 and epithelial CADM1/trophoblast NECTIN3 are predicted contacts in Fig7B. They are phenomenologically mapped to heterophilic adhesion. FGF2/FGFR1 is predicted in Fig7B-C, with stromal FGF2 represented at a higher per-cell source rate than epithelial FGF2. An effective glandular secretion field separately drives whole-blastocyst chemotaxis: this is an explicit unvalidated hypothesis, NOT a named chemoattractant established by the paper. Likewise day-14 expression is extrapolated to 6-9 d.p.f. No measured receptor densities, CPM energies, diffusivities, cell-cycle or kinetic rates are available. The AXL-dependent return signal is a generic host-support variable, not a claimed molecular pathway. R428 acts on stromal AXL, not embryo proliferation. AXL drive is an effective PROS1-associated signaling proxy; the 6 h host response is not a measured receptor phosphorylation time or unique TAM binding. Invasive adhesion work favors stroma over inner embryo/cavity, while normal trophectoderm retains a cohesive coat. Matrix attachment is released as the local matrix degrades. All such mechanical coefficients are assumptions. MMP cleavage of ECM models the reported metalloprotease-cleavable hydrogel. Contact-induced invasive trophoblast and blastocoel deflation are approximations. Cells are explicit; the blastocoel Potts object is fluid, not a biological cell. Initial lineage counts are 2D section choices, not reported embryo cell totals. No future cells, imposed invasion direction, timed fates, target masks, or scheduled snapshots enter the dynamics. New cells arise only by division. Time unit=h; StopTime=72 h corresponds to 6-9 d.p.f.; 1 MCS=0.025 h. Length=nodes; dx_um=3 um/node; NodeLength=1 keeps all solver units in nodes. See source/model_grounding.md and source/parameters.csv for assumptions.

Function.Expression: if(l.y <= surface_y and (((abs(l.x-gland_x)<gland_r_in and l.y>=gland_y) or ((l.x-gland_x)^2+(l.y-gland_y)^2<gland_r_in^2 and l.y<gland_y)) == 0),1,0)

ChangeCellType.Condition: contact_hours >= invasion_contact_h and contact_maturation > 0.75 and fgf_sensed > 0.005

Gnuplotter.condition: abs(elapsed_hours-0)<0.001 or abs(elapsed_hours-24)<0.001 or abs(elapsed_hours-48)<0.001 or abs(elapsed_hours-60)<0.001 or abs(elapsed_hours-72)<0.001
